primary.title: Bank holiday next week: SBI, HDFC, others closed on these days between 25 and 31 May; check here
primary.summary: India's banks will be closed for two days next week, including May 27 for Bakrid. The RBI has declared nine holidays this month. Online banking remains operational during these closures, allowing customers to conduct transactions anytime.
